0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k!\rHave you been sending New-Year's Greetings to the families of Maple World? I suppose you must be, looking as bright-eyed and bushy-tailed as you do.
0.1: I've got a special gift for you as a show of thanks for spreading the joy. It can be yours for the low, low price of #b#e1000 Family Points#k#n!

yes.0: Good! Go forth and socialize! I'm counting on you, so do your best.

no.0: Aww, that's too bad. Think of all the days you could have brightened with a friendly greeting!

1.0: Wow, #b#ho##k! #nYou've already collected 1000 Family Points. Feels good greeting your fellow Maplers, doesn't it? I hope you didn't run into too many bad carrots. Anyways, you did a good job. I have a gift for you, do you want it now?

yes.0: Your new goodies are waiting for you in your inventory. Oh! I almost forgot. I have another gift for you if you reach #b1200 Family Points#k. Come and find me if you're interested.

default.0: You haven't greeted enough Maple families yet. You get 100 Family Points every time your greeting is accepted, and 20 Maple Points for every greeting you accept. Try harder! Remember, you need #b1000 Family Points#k!
